description: This file contains utility functions and logic for downloading and managing application packages, including handling URL retrieval, download retries, codebig and direct download mechanisms, and extraction procedures, primarily used in a device management context.

methods.name: tlsLog
methods.description: Logs TLS errors with timestamp to tlsError.log

methods.name: get_core_value
methods.description: Determines CPU core type (ATOM or ARM) from system info

methods.name: downloadApp_getFWVersion
methods.description: Extracts firmware version from /version.txt based on tags

methods.name: downloadApp_getBuildType
methods.description: Identifies build type (VBN, PROD, QA, DEV, etc.) from firmware version

methods.name: downloadApp_getVersionPrefix
methods.description: Generates version prefix by removing build type from firmware version

methods.name: getDownloadUrl
methods.description: Retrieves download URL from various sources, including local files and default URL, with URL validation and substitution

methods.name: IsDirectBlocked
methods.description: Checks if direct download is blocked based on timestamp and file existence

methods.name: IsCodeBigBlocked
methods.description: Checks if codebig download is blocked based on timestamp and file existence

methods.name: get_Codebigconfig
methods.description: Configures whether to use codebig or direct connection based on device and configuration

methods.name: getCodebigUrl
methods.description: Generates signed URL and authorization header for codebig download

methods.name: generateDownloadUrl
methods.description: Prepares curl command for download, handling codebig and URL specifics

methods.name: sendDownloadRequest
methods.description: Performs download via curl, with retries and error handling

methods.name: sendAppDownloadRequest
methods.description: Performs application download with curl, handling TLS and retries

methods.name: applicationDownload
methods.description: Main function to download application package, managing retries, codebig/direct logic

methods.name: applicationExtraction
methods.description: Extracts downloaded tar files into specified directory

methods.name: is_file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and outputs its basename
